summary.tldr: Exempts psychotherapy services from the goods and services tax and updates the Excise Tax Act for those services.
what_it_does: Adds psychotherapy services to the list of services that are exempt from goods and services tax under the Excise Tax Act.
Expands the Act's definition of practitioner to include people who practise psychotherapy, along with other listed health professions.
summary.background: The bill amends Part II of Schedule V of the Excise Tax Act, where GST-exempt services are listed.
